performed_via_github_app.description:
# Transforming Code Reviews with AI

## Features

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes. 

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues

**Agent note — shepherded to merge (PR task 17305, lane any-b, 2026-11-16)**

State: done (fixed_merged). This Renovate wrangler security update was CONFLICTING against current main and has been rebased and merged as `9958e92ac3eb5eb0ffe0e24625a062d5c8b67938`. The update had NOT been superseded — main still carried the old versions (wrangler 4.44.0 in the atlas-search and github-ci workers; ^3.90.0 in the id hosted-worker and worker-poc).

What the shepherd did: merged current main into the branch twice (main moved the atlas-search worker package twice during the pass — vitest-pool-workers 0.23.0 / vitest ^4.1.0 landed in between), resolving the package.json conflicts by keeping main's newer pins and applying only the wrangler bumps (4.44.0 → 4.59.1; ^3.90.0 → ^4.0.0), and regenerated the atlas-search `package-lock.json` with `npm install --package-lock-only` so the lock's root and resolved wrangler entries both read 4.59.1 (the 4.44.0 copy nested under @cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers is that package's own pin and remains). Versions verified in the merged tree. The worker test suites were not run by the shepherd (lock-only install); the bumps ride the workers' normal CI from here.
